parameters.subject: Nuevo Embajador Registrado - The Money Command

parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT id FROM tokens_embajador WHERE token=$1 AND estado='activo' AND (expira_en IS NULL OR expira_en > now()) LIMIT 1) AS token_id;

WITH c AS ( INSERT INTO contactos (nombre, email, idioma, tipo) VALUES ($2, $3, $4::idioma_enum, 'embajador') ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET nombre=EXCLUDED.nombre, tipo='embajador', actualizado_en=now() RETURNING id ), e AS ( INSERT INTO embajadores (contacto_id, estado, acceso_apps, alta) SELECT id, 'activo', true, CURRENT_DATE FROM c ON CONFLICT (contacto_id) DO UPDATE SET estado='activo', acceso_apps=true RETURNING id ), tok AS ( UPDATE tokens_embajador SET estado='usado', usado_por_contacto_id=(SELECT id FROM c), usado_en=now() WHERE id=$1 AND estado='activo' RETURNING id ) SELECT (SELECT id FROM c) AS contacto_id, (SELECT id FROM e) AS embajador_id, (SELECT id FROM tok) AS token_usado;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "ok": false, "error": "token no válido o ya usado" } }}
